title: CatalogEventData
description: Payload carried in the `data` field of a catalog CloudEvent. The CloudEvent envelope itself (id, type, source, subject, time) is defined by the CloudEvents 1.0 spec; this schema only describes `data`.

kind.description: Entity kind, e.g. Component, Resource, API. Duplicated out of `entity` so consumers can route without parsing the full body.

entity.description: Full Backstage entity at the time of the event. Omitted on `io.backstage.catalog.entity.removed`.

previousEntity.description: Previous entity. Present on `changed` and `removed`, absent on `added`.
